pairs.subject: ipc-contract
pairs.evidence: src/athena/contracts/channel.py:44 The cross-boundary contract shapes are declared as standalone Python dataclasses without code generation to emit matching TypeScript or Rust declarations, leading to hand-maintained mirrors and partial regex parity tests.

techniques.evidence: tests/contracts/test_harness.py:44 Timeout reasons distinguish outcome_unknown from timeout, but the seam provides no call wrapper or named timeout classes for operations.
src/athena/contracts/channel.py:341 Event deserialization silently drops keys not matching Python field names, masking mis-cased fields into defaults instead of failing loudly.
src/athena/contracts/registry.py:311 ToolEntry enforces namespacing syntax and origin rules on tools, but the seam does not implement D/R/I/P set-parity reconciliation.
tests/contracts/test_manifest.py:228 Hand-curated regex checks on specific export strings substitute for an automated regenerate-and-diff gate and inventory comparison.
src/athena/contracts/harness.py:119 Error reasons are constrained to an explicit closed tuple vocabulary and normalized through normalize_reason.
tests/contracts/test_channel.py:223 Hand-authored TypeScript interfaces are regex-parsed for parity in tests rather than generating client types mechanically from Python contract classes.
